name: Nebula
description: Dark, glass-surfaced template for high-impact, futuristic presentations.

layouts.description: Opening cover slide for a presentation: a large left-aligned headline over generous negative space, a short kicker label, a one-line subtitle, and a compact presenter/date footer. Use for the first slide of a deck.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Kicker label, headline, and supporting subtitle stacked on the left.

runs.text: One clear line framing why this presentation matters right now.

components.description: Bottom metadata row with presenter and date.

layouts.description: Agenda or roadmap slide introducing the sections of the presentation as a numbered list, with a short eyebrow label and section title above it. Use for a contents or overview slide near the start of the deck.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Eyebrow label and section title above the agenda list.
Numbered list of agenda sections.

items.text: Market context and the opportunity ahead
What we need from this room

layouts.description: KPI or highlights slide showing three to four key metrics as glass tiles in a row, each with a large number and a short label. Use for a by-the-numbers or highlights summary slide.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Title and short supporting line above the stat row.

runs.text: The headline metrics from this quarter.

components.description: Row of four glass stat cards.

layouts.description: Ecosystem or operating-model slide showing several equal, connected dimensions arranged in a wheel around a shared center. Use for a slide about roles, pillars, or interlocking parts of a system.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Title and short supporting line above the wheel.

runs.text: Five pillars that move together, not in isolation.

components.description: Segmented wheel showing five operating-model pillars.

elements.takeaway: Five interlocking pillars keep the operating model resilient.
elements.name: operating_model_wheel

layouts.description: Sequential process slide showing an ordered, directional pipeline of steps from left to right. Use for a slide walking through how work moves from start to finish.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Title and short supporting line above the pipeline.

runs.text: The same four steps, every engagement.

components.description: Chevron process showing four delivery steps.

elements.takeaway: Every engagement moves through the same four disciplined steps.
elements.name: delivery_pipeline

layouts.description: Single-chart slide pairing one business metric chart with a short supporting text block beside it. Use for a slide centered on one data story, such as revenue, growth, or performance over time.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Title above the chart.
Bar chart of quarterly revenue.

elements.takeaway: Revenue grew every quarter, closing 72% above Q1.
elements.name: revenue_chart

components.description: Short supporting narrative beside the chart.

runs.text: Each quarter outpaced the last, driven by expansion revenue from existing accounts rather than new logos alone.

layouts.description: Side-by-side comparison slide with two glass cards, each covering one topic or state with a heading and short body text. Use for before/after, option A vs option B, or two-topic comparison slides.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Title above the two comparison cards.
Two glass cards placed side by side.

runs.text: Manual handoffs, disconnected tools, and reporting that lags a full week behind reality.
One connected workflow with live reporting and no manual handoffs left in the loop.

layouts.description: Closing slide that mirrors the opening cover with a large, simple statement and no subtitle. Use for the final slide of a deck, such as a thank-you or call-to-action slide.

components.description: Full-bleed dark background wash for the slide.
Large centered closing statement.
Small closing footer line.
